# Parlot SDK docs

> Public documentation for the Parlot open-source SDK — OpenTelemetry instrumentation for multi-agent voice AI (LiveKit today).

Canonical site root: https://parlot.ai/docs/
Also see the domain-wide index at https://parlot.ai/llms.txt

## Docs

- [Overview](https://parlot.ai/docs/): SDK docs home.
- [Quick Start](https://parlot.ai/docs/quick-start): Install, configure(), and export OTLP.
- [Concepts](https://parlot.ai/docs/concepts): Sessions, turns, handoffs, escalation, metadata, agent identity, generative AI content capture.
- [Guides](https://parlot.ai/docs/guides/): Integration guide index.
- [LiveKit](https://parlot.ai/docs/guides/livekit): Checklist, recording, egress, webhooks, contract maps, and OTEL coverage.
- [LangGraph](https://parlot.ai/docs/guides/langgraph): LangGraph / LangChain instrumentation.

## Optional

- [Changelog](https://parlot.ai/docs/changelog): Release notes.
- [Sitemap](https://parlot.ai/docs/sitemap.xml): All indexed doc URLs.
